name: Project: Afternight
desc:
[ ⚠️ THIS IS A BETA RELEASE! This game is still in active development, and not fully polished. ]
[ ⚠️ WARNING: This game has flashing lights, screen shakes and jumpscares! ]

Beatbox game, what else?

Project: Afternight is a casual, heavily customizable rhythm game inspired by Friday Night Funkin' (FNF), and its mods, with content from other games/media available as well. 
Get on a speaker to battle other players on nearly 4,000 different songs across several difficulties.

Best played on desktop, but mobile and console are also supported.
Join the community for news and sneak peeks!

- Credits to The Funkin' Crew for the original Friday Night Funkin' assets.
- Credits to various mod authors & musicians used can be seen in-game.
